normalization: reuse log1p(CP10K) over original genes then train-selected 2000 features
selection: the same 16 ready cases; no new sample exclusion
validation: matched validation-condition mean expression RMSE, equal conditions within drug then equal drugs; max1000 epochs/patience50
test_target_access: only shared scorer after all six model predictions are sealed

prediction_contract.zero_dose: same inference control population and same model; drug-specific zero-dose branch where required

prespecified_prediction_views.calibrated: delta = model_treated_mean - model_zero_dose_mean; absolute = observed_control_mean + delta
prespecified_prediction_views.reporting: report both; no test-based selection of anchor or checkpoint

metrics.delta_rmse: per well sqrt(mean_g((pred_delta - (true_treated_mean - observed_control_mean))**2)); equal wells within drug then equal drugs
metrics.delta_pearson: correlation across gene-wise changes; undefined zero-variance vectors stay NaN, report valid-well coverage
metrics.absolute_r2: sklearn definition 1-SSE/SST across gene-wise treated means, not squared Pearson
metrics.aggregation_of_seeds: compute each full experiment separately; mean and sample SD (ddof=1) across three seeds

references.lexa_retrieval_v3: historical supervised-response reference, separate information condition
references.expression_interpolation: same training-response interpolation as existing experiment

limitations: 5uM targets already unblinded in prior work: development comparison, not new independent generalization test
CPA/CODEX supervised on other-dose responses; pure LEXA+DeepSeek consumes mechanism/code semantics at inference, not matched-response retrieval
Matched data protocol is ours; models are adapted author implementations, not reproduction of paper or leaderboard scores
No matched single-cell pre/post pairing; outputs and metrics are population means
